posts.videoTitle: Peppers, lettuce, an avocado, a bowl of tomatoes. That is dinner.
posts.text:
Red peppers, a head of lettuce, an avocado, a bowl of cherry tomatoes, a cucumber, a handful of pine nuts. Add the board to iEatz and it writes tonight: peppers and tomatoes blistered in the pan, lettuce and cucumber dressed underneath, avocado on top, pine nuts toasted dry and scattered over. With a can of chickpeas from the shelf, about 18 g of protein per serving, estimated. Verify for allergens.

#weeknightdinner #whatsfordinner #saladfordinner #highproteinmeals #ieatzhealthy
posts.firstComment: The pine nuts are the only thing on this table that counts as optional.

posts.text:
$34.00 at the register: chicken breast, broccoli, ground beef, sweet potatoes, two cans of black beans, a can of corn, tortillas, a bag of frozen shrimp and a zucchini.

Four dinners from The Real Food Cookbook, every one under 30 minutes: one-pan garlic chicken and broccoli, ground beef and sweet potato skillet, black bean and corn quesadillas, shrimp and zucchini stir-fry. The garlic, oil and spices were already home. Every recipe in the book has a tap-to-shop Instacart list, so the receipt builds itself.

Want the other 26? Comment COOKBOOK and we'll DM you the cookbook. Free.

#mealplanning #weeknightdinner #30minutemeals #budgetmeals #ieatzhealthy

posts.text:
6:05 PM, the last of the cilantro going soft in the drawer. Blitz it with the parmesan end, olive oil, a squeeze of lemon and a clove of garlic; toss with linguine and a ladle of the pasta water. 15 minutes, about 17 g of protein per serving, estimated.

Add the five to iEatz and it writes this one, or whatever your fridge version is. Verify for allergens.

#pastarecipes #foodwaste #15minutemeals #pantrymeals #ieatzhealthy
posts.firstComment: Works with parsley, basil, the top of the carrots. Anything green and going.

Seam label: Herbs to pesto. Caption: The wilting bunch, the parmesan end, olive oil, a lemon, a bag of linguine. Add the five to iEatz. 15 min.

posts.text:
Sunday, 4:12 PM: every green gets a job. Kale is soup. Spinach goes in the eggs. Lemons are the dressing. Cucumber is lunch. Decide it now and nothing goes soft by Thursday.

Add the week's produce to iEatz on Sunday and it writes the dinners around it, calories and protein included.

#mealprep #sundayreset #foodwaste #weeknightdinner #ieatzhealthy
